terrace_revision.issue: Current native 960x540 hero's smooth triangle dominates sparse, near-linear cliff strokes. The original painting's dark nested hill-backs and crowded hemp-fibre texture are missing.

source_interpretation.macro: Interlocking, overlapping hill-backs with changing curvature and broad blank gullies; secondary crests descend from a single mountain parent.
source_interpretation.meso: Three non-identical loaded curved backs, opposite turns, short grouped alum-head cap shadows and two unequal hemp-fibre concentrations on each parent.
source_interpretation.micro: Width-modulated pigment belly, thin dry tails, 40 source-oriented attached fibres and intentionally unmarked midstation gaps.
